title: Distal Nephron Transport Transcription in Tumour Nephrectomy and Experimental Obstruction: analysis code and source data
description: Reproducible donor-level analysis of fixed distal-nephron transport programs in GSE254185, with primary single-nucleus and secondary single-cell cross-injury comparisons from GSE183277 and GSE183276, and animal-level obstruction/recovery analyses from GSE96102. The release contains donor aggregates, fluorescence inputs, source identifiers, fixed gene memberships, complete effect estimates and sensitivity analyses. Human discovery compares five obstructed upper-tract urothelial carcinoma nephrectomies with seven unobstructed renal tumour nephrectomies. The fixed magnesium program has lower scores in this comparison, secondary human acute kidney injury and acute experimental obstruction; the primary external single-nucleus comparisons have wide confidence intervals. Version 0.7.0 aligns cohort annotation and figure presentation while preserving the numerical analysis.
